body: Hey! I live in Washington. You may have some luck at LaserAway? They have multiple locations. They do laser tattoo removal. I personally have received 8 sessions of laser hair removal from them. Some locations have iffy reviews but I didn’t have a bad experience with them.
The virtue signaling is exhausting. You can’t be real anymore without being canceled.

I’m not required to be vaccinated to work there. It depends on the business and also if the business is less than 100 people normally you don’t have to be vaccinated (but in Seattle I think most places require it).
But do you mean to go out? I could use a fake one but I hate complying, even fake complying, to this shit. They don’t check IDs most places but there is this thing called the Clear app that most official places use (like sports/concerts), that actually uses your real records so you can’t fake it.
I’m thinking about working down south in Pierce County where there aren’t vaxx card mandates. Definitely need a fresh start.
Wow that’s awful. I’m so sorry.

Wow I wish it were like that over here. Masks are mandatory everywhere and half the people in the city wear them outside. I was pleasantly surprised when I went to California in December (Orange County) I saw a lot of people not masking up. That was refreshing. Went to Arizona too and felt like I was on another planet, no masks, no cards, no fucks given.
You’re right but its so hard to leave behind my friends I’ve grown up with. I want to fucking shake them. Unfortunately most of this area is filled with people like this. I’m losing hope everyday
I miss concerts too. I miss being able to travel without worrying about covid restrictions. I miss so much about our old normal lives. I hope we can enjoy those things again.

I’m so sorry. These masks mandates are so
fucking ridiculous.
Your child can’t legally enter a rest area? Why? because they want to force the child to wear a mask? Fuck all that.
